method: Built-in image editing; precise source-grounded wording corrections

edits.prompt:
Edit target: the provided Korean smart-farm explanation image. Preserve the polished style, ALL existing information, two separate horizontal lanes, illustrations, colors, large typography and arrows. Make only these precise Korean wording corrections/additions for accuracy. Do not regenerate unrelated content or delete any of the seven numbered plan inputs. Keep it easy to read.

1. In the green joining-rule strip under the two data sheets, replace "같은 시설 + 조사일이 포함된 재배기간" with "같은 시설 + 조사일이 속한 유일한 재배기간". If necessary wrap neatly into two lines. Immediately nearby in a short readable caption add "총량·누계 여부는 현장 확인".
2. In the top-right green validation bar, replace "같은 시설은 학습·검증에서 분리" with "같은 시설은 학습·검증에 겹치지 않음".
3. In the bottom-left footer with laptop icon, replace "미개방 자료는 합성 40시설·80작기로 실행 확인" with "미개방 자료용 코드를 합성 40시설·80작기로 실행 확인". This is essential: the real private data were not obtained; the code was tested using synthetic fixtures.
4. In the orange lane's left data card, retain "수량·농가수취가격·비용" and "2020–2024 · 266행"; add a clear readable short line "연간 1기작 · 1,000㎡ 기준". It can use remaining card space and natural line breaks. The middle card already says the user's area; this explains the source normalization.
Preserve all other labels and meanings exactly, including two independent pathways, prediction targets, source types, 7 inputs, model names and status. Do not shrink the whole image's text. No new numerical results or claims. The final output should be a beautiful, coherent corrected version of the same image.

Edit target: the provided Korean infographic titled "어떤 데이터를 실제로 썼나요?". Preserve the same layout, illustrations, visual hierarchy, colors, large readable text, source counts and EVERY existing data limitation. Make ONLY these two substantive corrections:

1. In the green common model-comparison band below the four cards, replace the heading "농가 자료 모델 비교:" with "딸기·5품목·ADP 실험:". Preserve the algorithm labels "중앙값", "CatBoost", "XGBoost", "LimiX-2 400M". Preserve the line "같은 시설·농가는 학습과 검증에 겹치지 않음 · 그룹별 5분할". This band applies ONLY to those three farm datasets, not the RDA aggregate-income fourth card.
2. In the fourth orange card "농촌진흥청 소득자료", preserve the original count "2020–2024 · 266행" and all existing calculation and assumption lines. Add one readable short line: "수량 예측도 비교 · 2024년 지역자료로 검증". Place neatly without shrinking the entire card's text or covering illustrations. A slight local spacing adjustment is allowed.
Do not alter the 400→77/61, 1474→192/146, 237→170/127 counts or any other numbers. Do not add arrows between source cards. Keep the footer saying public/member experiments are done and real private-data validation is separate. This is a surgical text correction of an already good design, not a new layout.
